primary_goal: launch soon enough to learn from real users and create first revenue without weakening research, compliance, or public-output gates
strategic_decision: Launch Quellwert as a trusted non-advice research surface with a paid founder cohort while keeping Room16 as the internal evidence engine.
revenue_thesis: Launch a public trust surface with methodology, archive, and safe sample analyses.
Sell a limited founding cohort before building a heavy membership platform.
Keep paid output as evidence-backed company research and decision context, not personalised investment advice.
Use custom research/dossier work as the fastest cash bridge while membership proof develops.

launch_lanes.goal: first recurring revenue with controlled scope
launch_lanes.delivery_mode: manual first via payment link or invoice and email/Notion/locked page delivery

launch_lanes.goal: keep internal research useful without pretending it is public-ready automation
launch_lanes.policy: Do not relax guards, ratings, calibration, reports, or public output from 1D/5D alone.

actions: Finalise landing, analyses, methodology, archive, imprint, privacy, and contact routes.
Run visual, content, legal-copy, and no-trading-token verifiers.
Publish public preview after operator gate.
Send first private announcement to warm network.
Ask whether users would pay for weekly evidence-backed company research.
Convert 5-10 founding users or sell 1-3 custom dossiers.
Create first paid brief from already-safe internal material.
Keep company-specific action language behind compliance review.
Publish one public article per week.
Publish one paid research brief per week.
Add simple member archive only if paid users exist.
Decide by day 30 whether to double down, narrow niche, raise price, or pivot offer.

day_14: 5+ paid founding users or 1+ paid custom dossier
day_30: 500-2000 EUR monthly run-rate or clear evidence-based niche pivot
success_metrics.quality_floor: No public material bypasses promotion gate, non-advice, human source verification, and operator go.
